Trace the forward-selection algorithm

Source: R/aimTrace.gwasAim.R, R/aimTrace.qtlAim.R
aimTrace.Rd

Prints a p-value matrix and likelihood ratio test (LRT) table showing the incremental state of the forward-selection algorithm across iterations, and optionally returns diagnostic plots.

The p-value matrix shows the p-value of each detected QTL (or marker) at every iteration in which it was present in the model, making it easy to assess whether effects remain stable as further QTL enter.

The LRT table records the base and full model log-likelihoods, the LRT statistic, and its p-value at every iteration including the final non-significant one.

For multivariate analyses (Trait non-NULL), the p-value matrix shows the main-effect p-value per QTL per iteration, and the stability plot shows per-trial effect estimates coloured by trial level.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gwasAim'
aimTrace(
  object,
  iter = seq_along(object$QTL$diag$coef.list),
  lik.out = TRUE,
  plot = FALSE,
  print.out = TRUE,
  sig.col = "firebrick",
  ncol = NULL,
  ...
)

aimTrace(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'qtlAim'
aimTrace(
  object,
  iter = seq_along(object$QTL$diag$coef.list),
  lik.out = TRUE,
  plot = FALSE,
  print.out = TRUE,
  sig.col = "firebrick",
  ncol = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted object of class "qtlAim" or "gwasAim".

iter

Integer vector of iterations to include in the p-value matrix. Default is all iterations: seq_along(object$QTL$diag$coef.list).

lik.out

Logical. If TRUE (default), print the LRT table. Only has an effect when print.out = TRUE.

plot

Controls optional diagnostic plot output. One of:

FALSE (default)

No plot is returned.

"lrt"

Returns a ggplot of the LRT statistic across iterations with the significance threshold marked and each detected QTL labelled.

"stability"

Returns a ggplot of QTL effect estimates \(\pm\)1 SE (points with error bars) across every iteration in which the QTL was in the model, one facet per QTL. For multivariate analyses a facet_grid(trial x QTL) layout is used with one panel per trial per QTL. Large jumps suggest confounding.

"both"

Returns a named list list(lrt = ..., stability = ...) invisibly.

print.out

Logical. If TRUE (default), the p-value matrix and (when lik.out = TRUE) the LRT table are printed to the console. Set to FALSE to suppress all console output and return only the plot, which is useful when calling aimTrace() inside a vignette or report where only the graphic is needed.

sig.col

Colour for highlighted points and error bars in diagnostic plots. Default "firebrick".

ncol

Integer. Number of columns in the facet_wrap layout of the "stability" plot for univariate analyses. Defaults to NULL, which uses 3 columns (or fewer if there are fewer QTL). Ignored for multivariate analyses, which use facet_grid(trial ~ qtl) regardless.

...

Further arguments (e.g.\ digits) passed to methods.

Value

NULL invisibly when plot = FALSE; a ggplot when plot is "lrt" or "stability"; a named list list(lrt, stability) when plot = "both".

See also

qtlAim, gwasAim, summary.qtlAim, summary.gwasAim

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# After running qtlAim():
aimTrace(qtl.fit)
aimTrace(qtl.fit, plot = "lrt")
aimTrace(qtl.fit, plot = "stability")
} # }
